projects.name: PHOENIX
projects.fullTitle: Precision Human Organs-on-chip for Enhanced Neuro-muscular and Cardiac Studies
projects.description: PHOENIX aims to revolutionise biomedical research by developing the next generation of human-based Organs-on-Chips. Two platforms will be developed: μHeart, to model functional cardiac tissues, and μNMC to model neuro-muscular circuits — both integrating real-time electric recording, force sensing, and mechanical stimulation.

projects.name: BuonMarrow
projects.fullTitle: Bone Marrow-on-Chip as smart sensor of lung cancer relapse
projects.description: BuonMarrow will develop an in vitro miniaturized bone marrow device able to harness the amplified BM-MSC response generated by liquid biopsy of lung cancer patients, acting as a biological sensor for the early detection of cancer relapse.

projects.name: SINERGIA
projects.fullTitle: Advanced technologies for drug discovery and precision medicine: in vitro modelling human physiology and disease
projects.description: SINERGIA was an Innovative Training Network that trained 15 early-stage researchers across Europe in organ-on-chip technologies, advanced in vitro modeling, and precision medicine — building the next generation of OoC scientists.

projects.name: AI-RITMIA
projects.fullTitle: AI-assisted personalized heart-on-chip as advanced diagnostic tool for clinical significance assessment of inherited cardiomyopathies
projects.description: AI-RITMIA will develop an unprecedented AI-guided patient-specific heart-on-chip diagnostic tool, interfacing in vitro modeling, in silico simulation, and AI-based data handling to enable unbiased correlations of clinical outcomes for patients carrying unclassified genetic variants.

societies.name: EUROoCS
societies.description: An independent, not-for-profit organization established to encourage and develop Organ-on-Chip research across Europe. Marco Rasponi has served as Chair of EUROoCS since July 2025.

societies.name: iMPSS
societies.description: iMPSS works towards enhancing the application of Microphysiological Systems in life sciences by accelerating regulatory acceptance through international collaborations and by educating the next generation of MPS scientists.

spinoff.name: BiomimX
spinoff.fullName: BiomimX S.r.l. — Spin-off of Politecnico di Milano
spinoff.description: BiomimX is a spin-off company of Politecnico di Milano co-founded by MiMic Lab. It develops and commercializes the patented uBeat technology — mechanically active organ-on-chip platforms for drug discovery and preclinical testing.
